``Shit, I drank too much last night, didn't I?``

Her keen hare's nose sniffed the room, noticing something different. What was it...? Well, maybe she'd find out once out of bed. 

She lived alone, had the luxury of waking up whenever she wanted and doing whatever she wanted without reproach, as long as it meant going to class responsibly. Because that's what she was, an adult, responsible, independent hare woman who... lived alone? 

Clank, clank! she heard the rattle of her silverware in the kitchen, immediately sitting up in bed. 

``Huh-``
She feels some confusion at the sight of his undressed lower half, showing off her morning erection.Why had she slept naked- Clank. 

With no time to think about it, she pulls on a pair of boxers from the floor, and goes to the kitchen, grabbing a baseball bat before entering. She's going to kick the shit out of the poor bastard who decided to sneak in. 

But what she finds shocks her. Breakfast perfectly prepared on the table, steaming coffee and toast with butter and honey. 

And behind that one, the guy who-now she remembered-she had fucked last night. 

But... why was he still here? 

“Hey... this is...” She scratches her neck. what the fuck would she say to him, 'yesterday was just a one night stand, go away' she couldn't. “...Why are you still here?” 

Your eyes full of illusion made her curse inside.
